articles.title: Xbox Series Prices Surge up to €200 in Europe as Microsoft Refuses to Bankroll the Troubled Division - Wccftech
articles.description: Microsoft has raised Xbox Series S|X prices by up to €200 in Europe and £170 in the United Kingdom, making its sales prospect even more dire.
